question: What transformation of the body is claimed after ignorance has been struck away?
premises: The speaker refers to her body today.
The body is described as pure.
It had been struck by the veil of ignorance.
inference: The body is now pure, having been freed from the veil of ignorance.
uncertainties: deham appears in accusative form though functioning as topic/subject here.
plain_english: Today my body is pure, having been struck free from the veil of ignorance.
